# BANK-0302 execution report

Status: DONE

The processor now maps a Fineract domain rejection (for example insufficient
funds) to channel `FAILED`, persists a bounded `failure_reason`, and emits a
failed status outbox event. An authorized USD 999,999,999 test transfer returned
`PROCESS=FAILED` and the channel row was `FAILED`; the temporary order and
identity were removed without a core transaction.

Transfer creation now writes the business row and `transfer_outbox` event in the
same channel transaction. Replay of an idempotency key returns before a second
outbox event can be inserted. Transfer state reads are exposed through the
operations contract, and the channel database includes a unique consumer/event
Inbox table with an atomic claim service for duplicate event suppression.

# BANK-0403 execution report

Status: DONE

Added an Operations Web surface at `/ops/` showing review queue, clearing state,
and reconciliation status. Risk approval now requires a non-empty reason and
current version in addition to distinct Maker/Checker subjects. The page is
static and intentionally does not bypass protected Operations API authorization.

# BANK-0404 execution report

Status: DONE

The deterministic mock-clearing E2E runner is available at
`scripts/test/mock-clearing-e2e.ps1`. It exercises SUCCESS, TIMEOUT, DUPLICATE,
and OUT_OF_ORDER scenarios, repeats callbacks to verify at-least-once behavior,
and receives HMAC signatures from the channel service. It requires an explicit
internal-realm bearer token and transfer ID; no credentials are committed.

An authorized internal-realm request through the Gateway submitted the SUCCESS
scenario and received `PENDING` with clearing id
`2c3c637d-800e-444f-afd0-3a954d5b2e47`; the risk evaluator returned `ALLOW`.
Callback sequence replay was verified: sequence 1 returned `SETTLED`, a replay
returned `DUPLICATE_IGNORED`, sequence 3 reported `outOfOrder=true`, and the
HMAC signature was 64 hex characters. Transfer-settlement reconciliation remains
open.

The repeatable `scripts/test/mock-clearing-e2e.ps1` was then run with a
temporary `PAYMENT_OPERATOR` token against transfer
`9c06f943-cb8a-4adb-8fc1-6d2923ffc74d`; SUCCESS, TIMEOUT, DUPLICATE and
OUT_OF_ORDER and RETURNED all returned PASS. Temporary identity, client and
clearing test rows were removed. The returned state is channel-owned; funds
compensation uses the separate maker-checker reversal flow.

# BANK-0507 execution report

Status: DONE

Runtime evidence (2026-07-10): a temporary customer-linked channel application
referencing the active Fineract loan was sent to the close endpoint before its
obligations were met. The adapter mapped the core rejection to HTTP 409 and no
core loan mutation occurred. Temporary channel and Keycloak test data were
removed after the check.

Added protected Operations API commands for savings account block, unblock,
close, and prematureClose. The adapter validates the command allowlist and
forwards the request through Fineract's local API; no core database write is
performed by the channel service.

The adapter was corrected from the local Swagger contract to send
`reasonForBlock` and close date fields. An authorized internal-realm block then
unblock sequence completed through the Gateway, and a direct Fineract read
confirmed the account returned to `Active` / `None` sub-status. Close and
premature-close remain intentionally unexecuted to preserve the fixture.

Business-date support was enabled through Fineract's configuration REST API and
the repeatable `scripts/test/business-date-e2e.ps1` moved the business date to
2026-07-31, verified it, then restored 2026-07-10. This validates the time-
travel control path; a full maturity repayment schedule scenario remains open.

The one-period maturity fixture was then created through the channel API. The
core schedule reported maturity `2026-08-10`; Business Date was moved to
`2026-08-11`, the full USD 101.50 was repaid, and Fineract closed the loan with
zero outstanding. Business Date was restored to `2026-07-10` and temporary
identity data was removed.

# V5.4 外网演示系统与内网迁移基线

> 状态：文档与规划基线；不代表 v5.4 AI 测试平台已经在本仓库实现或完成企业联调。
> 更新：2026-07-14
> 上游方案：`docs/architecture/v5.4-reference/`

## 1. 项目定位

本项目建设的是可在外网环境演示的完整系统，包含两部分：

1. 基于开源 Fineract/Mifos X 的完整数字银行目标系统；
2. 面向该目标系统的完整回归测试平台：案例输入、人工成功 Baseline、RAG、HiAgent/Coze 编排适配、Midscene 视觉复刻、Playwright 脚本生成、独立验证、定时回归、失败事件、反向恢复、证据、审计和交付。

外网演示版不是降级版。它使用虚构或脱敏数据，不接入真实生产资金、监管系统或公司内网；通过评审后，保持业务与测试契约不变，迁移到公司内网并替换平台、模型、质量平台和认证适配器。

## 2. 双系统边界

```text
回归测试平台
  -> Customer Portal / Operations Console / Mifos X 等被测网页
  -> Gateway / Bank Channel Service
  -> Fineract API
  -> Fineract 核心账务
```

Fineract 仍是银行核心账务唯一事实源。回归平台可以观察、编排和验证，但不能绕过 Bank Channel Service、直接写 Fineract 数据库或把 AI 输出当作账务事实。

## 3. v4 银行基线与 v5.4 测试平台关系

V4 的落地要求已叠加 v5.4 兼容基线：V4 必须交付可人工重复、可重置、可观察、可比较和可审计的业务流程，不能先完成一个无法被回归平台稳定消费的银行系统，再通过旁路脚本补适配。详细映射见 [`docs/architecture/v4-v54-compatibility-baseline.md`](v4-v54-compatibility-baseline.md)。

| 层 | 当前依据 | v5.4 目标状态 |
|---|---|---|
| 银行核心 | v4 Fineract/Mifos、渠道服务、资金安全规则 | 保持不变，作为外网演示目标系统与内网迁移基线 |
| 测试目标与案例 | 当前 `contracts/`、`scripts/test/`、阶段报告 | 统一为 RegressionCase、Fixture、Baseline、人工成功事实 |
| AI 编排 | 当前主要为规划与 PoC 资产，尚非完整运行链 | HiAgentPattern + Coze/企业平台 Adapter，企业接口仍待验证 |
| 浏览器自动化 | 当前已有前端与局部测试资产 | Midscene 原子动作 + Playwright 事实采集与独立 Runner |
| 交付与恢复 | 当前银行系统审计/恢复能力 | 脚本资产、定时回归、FailureIncident、两条 RecoveryOption 与通知闭环 |

## 4. 状态口径

- 银行核心当前状态继续以 `AGENTS.md`、审查报告、测试和运行证据为准；S7 未通过不因 v5.4 文档复制而改变。
- v5.4 的本地 PoC 结果只能标记为本地验证；HiAgent/Coze 企业租户、公司文本/视觉模型、真实质量平台、企业认证和内网迁移均标记为 `PENDING_ENTERPRISE_VALIDATION`，不得写成已完成。
- 非编程文档可以描述目标、契约和验收方式，但不得把目标架构伪装成当前实现。

## 5. 外网演示与内网迁移门槛

外网演示必须使用虚构/脱敏数据、显式环境隔离、最小权限、不可变镜像、无密钥入库、审计和回归证据。评审通过后迁移只替换：

- Agent 平台与租户适配器；
- 文本/视觉模型 Endpoint、模型 ID 和认证；
- 质量平台导入导出适配；
- 企业身份、通知和网络策略；
- 运行环境与凭据注入。

不得通过迁移删除资金安全门禁、独立脚本验证、Baseline、审计、失败解释或恢复流程。

## 6. 关联文档

- v5.4 完整冻结方案：`docs/architecture/v5.4-reference/`
- Docs/RAG 协作规范：`docs/rag-governance.md`
- 当前能力：`docs/architecture/current-capability-matrix.md`
- 当前验收：`docs/architecture/acceptance-matrix.md`
- 当前审查：`docs/evidence/v51-audit/audit-report.md`

# Risk register

Scope: banking-core Track and external-demo migration risks in the v5.4 combined product.
Frozen: 2026-07-11 as part of S0 baseline governance.

The v5.4 platform risks (enterprise Agent tenant, model endpoint, quality-platform adapter, external-demo edge security and intranet migration) are tracked in `docs/architecture/v5.4-external-demo-baseline.md` and must be added here before the relevant acceptance gate.

## Active risks

| ID | Severity | Finding | Required treatment | Stage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| R-001 | High | Fineract is `1.15.0-SNAPSHOT`; plugin compatibility is not established. | Default to an independent Customer BFF; require ADR and full regression before any Self Service Plugin decision. | S2 |
| R-002 | High | Core money-operation idempotency header is not declared in the local OpenAPI. | Use a channel-level `Idempotency-Key`, state machine, outbox/inbox and integration proof before money operations. | S2 |
| R-003 | High | External event configuration has 131 rows but 0 enabled. | Do not depend on core event delivery; use isolated channel events unless separately approved. | S2 |
| R-004 | Medium | ActiveMQ image previously retained a `latest` tag. | S0 has pinned version `6.1.2` with digest. Verify runtime matches in S1. | S1 |
| R-005 | Medium | Fineract and Mifos images use development tags paired with digests. | Treat observed digests as baseline; prohibit automatic image upgrades. Upgrade requires ADR + full regression. | S0 |
| R-006 | Medium | Docker Desktop depends on a manually configured machine proxy. | Keep address redacted; harden proxy exposure in a separate workstation task, not during channel work. | Ongoing |
| R-007 | Medium | Fineract has no Docker health check. | Use actuator health in integration and monitoring tests. S1 may add Docker healthcheck to core compose if approved. | S1 |
| R-008 | High | A channel reservation cannot prevent concurrent core-side debits by itself. | Design compensation, idempotency and reconciliation before payments; consider core freezing only after explicit approval. | S4 |
| R-009 | Medium | Current runtime ports (Gateway 18081, Keycloak 18082) differ from v4 targets (18443, 19000). | S0 documents v4 target ports; S1 migrat
es compose and Keycloak realm redirects. | S1 |
| R-010 | Medium | Current frontend apps are plain HTML/JS, not React/TypeScript per v4 spec. | S3 will rebuild Customer Portal and Operations Console using React/TypeScript/Vite per v4 section 5.1 and 13. | S3 |
| R-011 | Low | Keycloak internal realm is missing CUSTOMER_SERVICE and RISK_ANALYST roles from v4 section 12. | S1 will add all 11 v4 roles to bank-internal realm. | S1 |
| R-012 | Medium | No packages/ directory existed for shared TypeScript packages before S0. | S0 created directory skeleton; S3 populates bank-api-client, bank-ui-kit, bank-domain-types, bank-test-contracts, security-utils. | S3 |

## Risk rules

- Risks are reviewed at each stage exit.
- New risks discovered during a stage MUST be registered before stage exit.
- High-severity risks MUST have a treatment plan before the dependent stage begins.
- Closed risks are moved to a "Resolved" section with resolution evidence.

# WSL 侧 OpenCode Skill 库复刻指南

## 当前 Windows 侧布局

```
~/code/opencode-power-pack/          # git clone 的源仓库
  skills/                             # 11 个 SKILL.md 目录
    agents-md-improver/SKILL.md
    agents-md-revise/SKILL.md
    code-architect/SKILL.md
    code-explorer/SKILL.md
    code-review/SKILL.md
    code-reviewer/SKILL.md
    feature-dev/SKILL.md
    frontend-design/SKILL.md
    mcp-builder/SKILL.md
    security-review/SKILL.md
    skill-creator/SKILL.md
  commands/                           # 11 个斜杠命令 .md（已汉化 description）

~/.config/opencode/
  opencode.json                       # 插件配置（含 plugin 数组）
  commands/                           # 复制的斜杠命令文件

~/.local/bin/agnix                   # agnix CLI 二进制（v0.37.5）

~/.agents/skills/                    # arkcli 系统自带 skills（25 个）
~/.claude/skills/                     # 同上副本
```

## WSL 侧复刻步骤

### 1. 安装 opencode-power-pack 插件

```bash
# 编辑 WSL 侧 opencode 配置
mkdir -p ~/.config/opencode
cat > ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json << 'PATCH'
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "plugin": [
    "opencode-power-pack@git+https://github.com/waybarrios/opencode-power-pack.git",
    "agentsys"
  ]
}
PATCH
# 如果已有 opencode.json，只需把 plugin 数组合并进去
```

### 2. 克隆仓库并链接斜杠命令

```bash
# 克隆
git clone https://github.com/waybarrios/opencode-power-pack.git ~/code/opencode-power-pack

# 复制汉化后的命令文件（从 Windows 侧跨拷，或直接用原版后自行汉化）
mkdir -p ~/.config/opencode/commands
cp ~/code/opencode-power-pack/commands/*.md ~/.config/opencode/commands/

# 如需汉化 description，逐个编辑 frontmatter：
# sed -i 's/^description:.*/description: 你的中文描述/' ~/.config/opencode/commands/code-review.md
```

### 3. 安装 agnix CLI

```bash
# 方式 A：直接用 Windows 侧的二进制（通过 WSL 互操作）
# agnix.exe 在 PATH 中可直接调用，但路径检查可能不兼容

# 方式 B：下载 Linux 二进制（推荐）
curl -L -o /tmp/agnix.tar.gz \
  https://github.com/agent-sh/agnix/releases/latest/download/agnix-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz
tar -xzf /tmp/agnix.tar.gz -C ~/.local/bin/
chmod +x ~/.local/bin/agnix
agnix --version
```

### 4. 汉化斜杠命令描述（11 个）

在 WSL 中执行以下脚本，批量替换 description 为中文：

```bash
declare -A descs=(
  ["agents-md-improver"]="审计并改进 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md 项目规则文件"
  ["agents-md-revise"]="将会话经验保存到 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md 项目记忆"
  ["code-architect"]="设计功能架构，输出实现蓝图（文件/组件/数据流/构建顺序）"
  ["code-explorer"]="深度分析代码库功能实现（追踪执行路径/映射架构层次）"
  ["code-review"]="审查 PR 或代码变更中的 bug、逻辑错误和规范违规"
  ["code-reviewer"]="审查代码 bug、安全漏洞和质量问题（置信度过滤）"
  ["feature-dev"]="引导式七阶段功能开发工作流"
  ["frontend-design"]="生成高质量前端界面（避免通用 AI 风格，自检可访问性）"
  ["mcp-builder"]="引导构建高质量 MCP 服务器（Python 或 TypeScript）"
  ["security-review"]="安全审查待提交变更中的真实可利用漏洞"
  ["skill-creator"]="创建和改进 SKILL.md 技能文件"
)

for cmd in "${!descs[@]}"; do
  file="$HOME/.config/opencode/commands/${cmd}.md"
  if [ -f "$file" ]; then
    desc="${descs[$cmd]}"
    # 替换 description 行
    sed -i "s/^description:.*/description: ${desc}/" "$file"
    echo "OK: $cmd -> $desc"
  fi
done
```

### 5. 验证

```bash
# 检查命令文件
ls ~/.config/opencode/commands/

# 检查插件配置
cat ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json | grep -A5 plugin

# 检查 agnix
agnix --version

# 重启 opencode 后在 TUI 中验证
# 按 Ctrl+P 打开命令面板，应看到 11 个斜杠命令
```

## 注意事项

- WSL 的 `~` 对应 `/home/<username>`，不是 `/mnt/c/Users/<username>`
- 如果 WSL 和 Windows 共享同一项目目录（`/mnt/d/Agent/banksystem`），只需在 WSL 侧配置 opencode 即可，项目文件无需复制
- agnix 在 WSL 中应使用 Linux 二进制（musl 静态链接），不要用 Windows exe
- opencode-power-pack 的 skills 目录由插件自动注册，无需手动复制到 `~/.config/opencode/skills/`
